measures: every expected public callable name, forbidden purpose, rank-like token, currentness token and attribute name is PINNED AS A LITERAL in the repair court and never read from the production module, so truncating or renaming a production constant makes the court FAIL rather than pass

non-authorization is proven by recursive VALUE INSPECTION of the emitted binding material for rank/score/priority/preference/weight leaves, with the negative disclaimer keys pinned and excluded so the scan targets real rank leaves
the single-source enforcement is proven by an A-bound/B-query refusal over a fixture where B is genuinely admitted, so nothing refuses by accident
the two modes are proven to DIFFER on that same fixture, where the review had measured same_result_hash(single vs exhaustive) = True
the AST inventory test asserts EQUALITY with a pinned 57-name inventory, so any added attribute read fails, rather than only asserting that a chosen subset is absent
the Repair 3 witness uses a forged receipt that deliberately BYPASSES the adopted owner, so the witness does not inherit the invariant it is testing
every repair was negative-controlled against the pre-repair binder extracted from the exact repair base
